commentary: Today, DCE iron ore futures trended weakly, with contract I2609 closing at 746 yuan/mt, up 0.88% from the previous trading day. Port spot prices rose by about 5-7 yuan/mt from the previous day. Trader acƟvity was average, and steel mills purchased on an as-needed basis. As of now, spot trading senƟment has been mediocre. The latest SMM survey data further conﬁrmed the weakening trend in iron ore demand. StaƟsƟcs show that the naƟonal blast furnace operaƟng rate fell to 89.78%, and daily average pig iron producƟon dropped to 2.4406 million mt, down 15,400 mt MoM. AddiƟonally, aﬀected by commemoraƟve events in Tangshan, local environmental protecƟon-related maintenance is expected to intensify, and the weakening trend in hot metal output is likely to strengthen further. In the short term, the bearish fundamental backdrop has deepened. However, given the currently high proporƟon of short posiƟons in the futures market, selling pressure is nearly exhausted, and the downward momentum for prices has begun to fade. Short-term ore prices are likely to consolidate and move sideways. Going forward, aƩenƟon should be paid to whether a reducƟon in short posiƟons could drive a price rebound.
